Woodhouse Basecamp

The cleaning app

How to use it

It tells you what to clean today, and it tells the office when you have finished.

The app is at:

What is in here

  1. Logging in
  2. Putting it on your phone
  3. What to clean today
  4. When you finish a building
  5. If something is broken
  6. Who is working this week
  7. Saying when you can work

Logging in

  1. Open the app on your phone.
  2. Tap your name.
  3. Tap your PIN. The last number logs you in.

You only do this once. The app remembers you next time.

Putting it on your phone

  1. Open the app in your phone’s browser.
  2. On an iPhone: tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.
  3. On Android: tap Install on the bar under the names.

You only do this once. The app then has its own icon, like any other app, and you never have to find the link again.

What to clean today

  1. The app opens on today’s list.
  2. Start at number 1 and work down.
  3. Tap a building to open it.

Check means a quick tidy and re-stock. Full Clean means the whole clean. A green Done means someone has already finished that building. The arrows at the top show another day, and every other building is under Other buildings at the bottom.

When you finish a building

  1. Tap the blue button.
  2. Tap Yes, all done.
  3. That is it. The office can see it is finished.

There is nothing to tick and nothing to hand in. Tapped it by mistake? Open the building again and tap Reopen.

If something is broken

  1. Tap Report.
  2. Say where it is and what is wrong.
  3. Tap Send.

Use it for lost property too. The office sees it straight away. You do not have to wait for an answer.

Who is working this week

  1. Tap Roster at the bottom of the screen.
  2. Your row shows the days you are on and your hours.
  3. Tap the arrows to look at another week.

The office writes the roster. If a shift looks wrong, ring them. A week that is not out yet will say so instead of showing you a half-finished one.

Saying when you can work

  1. Tap Roster, then My availability at the top.
  2. Tick the days you can work. Add hours if they matter.
  3. Tap Save as my usual week.

Tap the star on a day you would rather work. Use Save for this week only if it is a one-off. Saving does not move a shift you already have, so ring the office if one needs to change.
